result.instructions: Tools for ManyRequests, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which requests are due this week, and who is assigned to each?"; "Show the open requests for client Acme and their latest comments."; "List the unpaid invoices for the organization Northwind.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ManyRequests data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run manyrequests_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run manyrequests_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run manyrequests_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. manyrequests_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_clients

organization_id.description: Only clients in this organization id (filter[organization_id]).

sort.description: Sort by name, email, created_at. Prefix a field with - for descending order. Comma-separate several fields.

page.description: Page number. Use the next-page link (links.next) of the previous response to find the next page.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_requests

search.description: Search requests by title, number, client name or organization name (filter[search]).

status_id.description: Only requests in this status id (filter[status_id]).

priority.description: Only requests with this priority: low, medium or high (filter[priority]).

client_id.description: Only requests of this client id (filter[client_id]).

organization_id.description: Only requests of this organization id (filter[organization_id]).

service_id.description: Only requests of this service id (filter[service_id]).

assignee_ids.description: Only requests with these assignee ids, comma-separated (filter[assignee_ids]).

tag_ids.description: Only requests with these request tag ids, comma-separated (filter[tag_ids]).

due_from.description: Only requests due on or after this ISO 8601 date (filter[due_date][from]).

due_to.description: Only requests due on or before this ISO 8601 date (filter[due_date][to]).

number.description: Only the request with this number (filter[number]).

sort.description: Sort by created_at, updated_at, due_date, priority, position, number. Prefix a field with - for descending order. Comma-separate several fields.

page.description: Page number. Use the next-page link (links.next) of the previous response to find the next page.

tools.name: manyrequests_create_request
tools.title: Create a request
tools.description: CREATE a new service request for a client. Required: service_id, client_id, title. Visible to the client's portal once created; not undoable from this tool (there is no delete). API: POST /requests.

service_id.description: The service id the request belongs to (from manyrequests_list_services).

description.description: Request description (plain text or HTML as the API accepts).

brand_id.description: Brand id to use for the request.

assignee_ids.description: Team member ids to assign (from manyrequests_list_team_members).

tag_ids.description: Request tag ids (from the request tag list).

tools.name: manyrequests_create_request_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a request
tools.description: ADD a comment to one request. Set is_internal true to keep it staff-only; false (default) makes it visible to the client. Required: body, user_id (the team member who writes it). API: POST /requests/{requestKey}/comments.

request.description: The request id or slug (from manyrequests_list_requests).

user_id.description: The team member id who writes the comment (from manyrequests_list_team_members).

is_internal.description: true = internal note for staff only. Default: visible to the client.

scheduled_at.description: Send the comment later at this time, if the API supports it for the account.

annotations.title: Add a comment to a request
